messages:
Sam (People Ops): Heads up 5050 people 5050 we've had a few requests for a recurring 'hybrid hub' schedule (e.g., every other week in another state). Need quick alignment on stipend treatment + payroll flags. Thoughts?

Jules (Eng): Planning to try a 3-1 split (3 weeks home, 1 week at SF hub) starting June. Do I lose part of the monthly WFH stipend or keep full?

Nadia (Finance): If your homebase doesn't change (no >90 day continuous stay), benefits/benefit eligibility stay the same. For stipend we can either do full or pro-rate. Pro-rate approach reduces tax/documentation complexity for the company.

Aly (Legal): Quick legal note: frequency matters. Monthly hops might still create payroll tax exposure for the other state if the person performs work there regularly. We need to know client-facing activities or hiring/management duties. Low-touch engineering work is lower risk but still not 0.

Sam (People Ops): Proposal: default = pro-rate by calendar days in location. Option to request full stipend with manager + finance signoff if there's a business justification (e.g., permanent coworking seat charged). We'll make it opt-in.

Jules (Eng): How would proration work in practice? Example: 7 days in hub out of a 30-day month.

Nadia (Finance): Formula we'll use: (days_in_hub\u002Ftotal_days_in_month) * monthly_stipend. We'll round to nearest dollar. We'll also indicate any state withholding notes on the pay stub.

Sam (People Ops): Process for employees who want hybrid hub: 1) open People Ops case with pattern and addresses; 2) attach statement of work activities if client-facing; 3) select reimbursement vs stipend; 4) indicate if coworking is billed monthly to you or company. We'll respond with tax/benefit guidance.

PeopleOps-Bot: Case created #35999 "Jules - SF hub 3-1". Sam will triage.

Jules (Eng): If I choose company-covered coworking (they invoice), do I still get stipend?

Sam (People Ops): No, if company pays coworking directly there's no stipend duplication. We'll mark coworking as non-taxable reimbursement if paid directly to vendor.

Aly (Legal): Also flag: if you will be recruiting or interviewing local candidates while at hub, escalate before travel. That can trigger local employment nexus.

Jules (Eng): Good call. I might do a 1-day onsite interview while there occasionally. I'll note that on the case.

Nadia (Finance): One more practical: if proration is applied, payroll needs exact day ranges in the month before payroll cutoff. Please submit cases at least 10 business days before end of month so we can calculate withholding correctly.

IT-ShipBot: Note: IT will ship hardware to an alternate address only after People Ops case approved and IT ticket linked.

Jules (Eng): Understood. Will open case and IT ticket. Any attestation forms I should expect?

Aly (Legal): Possibly a short nonresident tax attestation for the hub state and an acknowledgment of tax filing responsibility if required. We'll attach templates to the case response.

Sam (People Ops): We'll draft a short "hybrid hub addendum" template for recurring patterns and a one-page FAQ. Will follow up in this thread with the draft and the FAQ link. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
